native.ua_edition: Actual reviewed service/mapping edition; another edition requires a separately registered schema.
native.ua_binding: Actual endpoint transport and encoding; application OPC UA does not choose an Ethernet PHY.
native.ua_direction: Actual request or response; receiver limits change with direction.
native.ua_security_family: Actual intended SecurityPolicy family, verified from profile URI and revision.
native.ua_security_mode: Actual advertised/selected MessageSecurityMode, separate TLS transport security.
native.ua_subprotocol: Actual WebSocket handshake subprotocol; binary UACP differs JSON/OpenAPI.
native.ua_message_type: Actual UACP/UASC message type, not CAN frame ID.
native.ua_chunk_type: Actual chunk continuation/final/abort; control messages are final.
native.ua_sequence_phase: Actual first chunk, ordinary next chunk, or qualified wrap.
native.ua_item_kind: Actual DataValue or Event monitored item; zero/one queue semantics differ.
native.ua_monitoring_mode: Actual disabled, sampling only, or reporting; publishingEnabled does not change it.
native.ua_discard_effect: Actual queue replacement on overflow, not generic DROP_NEWEST.
native.ua_data_trigger: Actual DataChangeTrigger; absent filter uses STATUS_VALUE.
native.ua_deadband: Actual DataChangeFilter deadband type; percent requires AnalogItem EURange.
native.ua_outcome: Actual application outcome separate transport/service/individual item status.
native.ua_endpoint: Actual advertised endpoint URL; no invented localhost/4840 application endpoint.
native.ua_transport_profile_uri: Actual endpoint TransportProfileUri and edition, not label-derived physical path.
native.ua_security_policy_uri: Actual configured SecurityPolicy URI; no automatic insecure None or stale archived policy.
native.ua_profile_source: Actual endpoint/profile/edition and supported security mode/URI evidence.
native.ua_peer_source: Actual client/server implementation, operation/encoding/queue and negotiated limits.
native.ua_security_source: Actual trust/certificates/nonces/validation and current policy evidence; do not store access tokens.
native.ua_schedule_source: Actual sampled/published/request traffic, service/scheduler and retry bounds.
native.ua_acceptance_source: Actual correlated per-operation status, data age and functional acceptance requirement.
native.ua_registered_source: Actual rules for different edition or registered transport/security mapping.
native.ua_connection_id: Actual transport connection identity, separate Session and SecureChannel.
native.ua_session_id: Actual Session identity; reconnect does not automatically terminate a Session.
native.ua_pending_connection_id: Actual connection associated with pending request/chunks.
native.ua_chunk_hex: Actual complete UACP wire chunk as octets; headers are little-endian and size includes header.
native.ua_protocol_requested: HEL requested UACP version; current mapping uses zero.
native.ua_protocol_revised: ACK negotiated version, no higher than HEL requested.
native.ua_hello_rx: Actual client HEL ReceiveBufferSize; whole response chunk, not Ethernet MTU.
native.ua_hello_tx: Actual client HEL SendBufferSize; whole request chunk.
native.ua_ack_rx: Actual server ACK ReceiveBufferSize, no higher than client send size.
native.ua_ack_tx: Actual server ACK SendBufferSize, no higher than client receive size.
native.ua_client_max_message: HEL maximum unencrypted response body; zero means no limit.
native.ua_server_max_message: ACK maximum unencrypted request body; zero means no limit.
native.ua_client_max_chunks: HEL maximum response chunk count; zero means no limit.
native.ua_server_max_chunks: ACK maximum request chunk count; zero means no limit.
native.ua_endpoint_utf8_bytes: Actual UTF8 endpoint character bytes, distinct binary String four-byte length prefix.
native.ua_endpoint_encoded_bytes: Actual binary endpoint String byte count including four-byte length prefix; table requires less than4096.
native.ua_chunk_bytes: Actual whole UACP/UASC chunk size including eight-byte connection header.
native.ua_message_body_bytes: Actual unencrypted assembled body size; not encrypted wire bytes or application object size.
native.ua_message_chunks: Actual chunk count in one message, direction-specific peer bound.
native.ua_channel_id: Actual UInt32 SecureChannel identifier in UASC chunk.
native.ua_token_id: Actual UInt32 security token; renew does not reset sequence number.
native.ua_sequence: Actual UInt32 chunk sequence; legacy and modern policies have distinct wrapping.
native.ua_previous_sequence: Actual preceding chunk sequence on same SecureChannel.
native.ua_request_id: Actual UASC UInt32 request identity, constant across its chunks and response.
native.ua_pending_request_id: Actual pending UASC request identity for response correlation.
native.ua_token_requested_ms: Actual OpenSecureChannel requested lifetime, not guaranteed revised lifetime.
native.ua_token_revised_ms: Actual server granted security token lifetime.
native.ua_renew_proposal_ms: Source SHOULD renew at75percent of granted lifetime; proposal, not guaranteed scheduler.
native.ua_session_requested_ms: Actual requested Session timeout; server may revise up or down.
native.ua_session_revised_ms: Actual granted Session timeout, separate request timeoutHint.
native.ua_publish_requested_ms: Actual requested publishing interval; zero/negative requests server fastest.
native.ua_publish_revised_ms: Actual server publishing interval, not assumed100ms or equal requested.
native.ua_keepalive_requested: Actual requested keep-alive count; zero requests server minimum.
native.ua_keepalive_revised: Actual server keep-alive count, not a packet retry count.
native.ua_lifetime_requested: Actual requested lifetime count; invalid revisable request values are revised, not transport errors.
native.ua_lifetime_revised: Actual granted Subscription lifetime count, at least3*actual keep-alive.
native.ua_notifications_limit: Actual maxNotificationsPerPublish; zero means unlimited notifications, not unlimited wire bytes.
native.ua_subscription_priority: Actual subscription relative priority Byte, unrelated VLAN PCP. No-special-priority proposal0.
native.ua_sampling_requested_ms: Actual sampling request; any negative is interpreted as inherited -1; zero requests fastest practical.
native.ua_sampling_revised_ms: Actual server sampling interval; at least requested unless request exceeds supported maximum.
native.ua_sampling_server_max_ms: Actual source-qualified maximum supported sampling interval, not a universal limit.
native.ua_queue_requested: Actual requested MonitoringParameters queueSize; data/event sentinel meanings differ.
native.ua_queue_revised: Actual server queue size, independent request and device capability.
native.ua_event_queue_min: Actual server minimum event queue capability.
native.ua_event_queue_max: Actual server maximum event queue capability.
native.ua_timeout_hint_ms: UInt32 per-call timeoutHint; zero means no timeout; server hint does not prove E2E deadline.
native.ua_max_age_ms: Actual Read maxAge; zero attempts fresh, >=MaxInt32 attempts cached, best effort may be older.
native.ua_deadband_value: Actual absolute units or percentage threshold; no engineering-unit fallback.
native.ua_eu_low: Actual EURange low in engineering units, not a generic0..100 signal scale.
native.ua_eu_high: Actual EURange high in same engineering units.
native.ua_deadband_threshold: Derived percent threshold=(percent/100)*(EURange high-low); notification comparison strictly greater.
native.ua_service_status: Actual overall UInt32 ServiceResult; Good does not imply every item Good.
native.ua_item_status: Actual per-item UInt32 StatusCode, severity separate info bits.
native.ua_item_severity: Decoded StatusCode top two bits0Good/1Uncertain/2Bad/3reserved treatedBad.
native.ua_ws_opcode: Actual selected WebSocket frame opcode, encoding dependent.
native.ua_ws_frame_bytes: Actual complete UA payload bytes carried by frame; separate WS header and TLS.
native.ua_ws_receiver_limit: Actual receiver internal limit for JSON/OpenAPI, no HEL/ACK negotiation.
native.ua_age_ms: Actual correlated source data age, not maxAge request or ServerTimestamp alone.
native.ua_freshness_limit_ms: Actual application accepted source-age limit, no protocol-wide100ms.
native.ua_legacy_sequence: Actual selected policy LegacySequenceNumbers flag; not inferred from arbitrary URI text.
native.ua_sequence_unused_for_token: Actual sequence not previously used for this TokenId, including after renew.
native.ua_session_activated: Actual successful ActivateSession before session-based services.
native.ua_session_service: Whether current service needs an activated Session; discovery/sessionless are separate.
native.ua_publishing_enabled: Actual notification publishing enable; does not change item monitoring mode.
native.ua_discard_oldest: Actual full-queue policy; false replaces last queued value, queue1 ignores flag.
native.ua_analog_item: Actual AnalogItem with EURange property when percent deadband is used.
native.ua_numeric_item: Actual numeric value supports absolute deadband; events/status changes have different rules.
native.ua_gzip: Actual negotiated/used gzip for HTTPS JSON or WS OpenAPI, not inferred from payload size.
native.ua_uncertain_accepted: Explicit application permission for Uncertain values, not protocol default.
native.ua_data_accepted: Actual functional acceptance of correlated operation/value.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application bytes distinct assembled unencrypted UA message body, directional chunks/security/wire overhead and selected bearer. No universal8byte/65535 ceiling or automaticEthernet rate.
